paper_title: Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models
caption: Number of tasks by language family.

annotations.annotation: The bar chart illustrates the number of tasks across different linguistic families or categories. The vertical axis contains the categories, labeled from top to bottom as IE-Slavic, IE-Romance, IE-Germanic, Uralic, IE-Baltic, IE-other, IE-Indic, Semitic, Turkic, and Basque. The horizontal axis is labeled as "# tasks", with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, with tick marks at intervals of 10. Each bar represents a linguistic family, with specific color coding for each: IE-Slavic is light blue, IE-Romance is dark blue, IE-Germanic is light green, Uralic is green, IE-Baltic is light pink, IE-other is red, IE-Indic is orange, Semitic is brown, Turkic is light purple, and Basque is dark purple. The longest bar, representing IE-Slavic, has an approximate length reaching 80 tasks, while the shortest, representing Basque, is around 5 tasks. The arrangement of the bars appears to be in descending order of task numbers from top to bottom. There's a sharp decline from IE-Slavic and IE-Romance, and IE-Germanic and Uralic. There is no additional visual emphasis such as shading or annotations applied to any of the bars.
